A '''major''' was sent from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Carida Academy/Legends|Academy of Carida]] to assess a potential recruit, [[Isila Drutch]]. After taking her through an intense, three [[Standard day/Legends|day]] physical assessment, [[Gender/Legends|he]] approved the transferring of her from the [[Parshoone Sector Service Academy]] to [[Carida/Legends|Carida]].
